2609.24613.title: UK-PRBENCH: A Paragraph-Level Precedent Retrieval Benchmark for United Kingdom Case Law
2609.24613.paper_summary: Prior case retrieval (PCR) aims to identify precedent cases relevant to a given query case. Existing PCR benchmarks and methods predominantly operate at the document level, treating entire judgments as the unit of relevance. This formulation is suboptimal for legal practitioners, as judgments address multiple legal issues and only a small subset of paragraphs is relevant to a particular query. Addressing this gap, we introduce UK-PRBench, a benchmark for paragraph-level precedent retrieval in UK case law, constructed from judgments obtained from the UK National Archives and covering a broad range of UK courts and tribunals. Furthermore, we evaluate state-of-the-art retrieval models and establish baseline results. Our experiments show that paragraph-level precedent retrieval remains challenging for current retrieval approaches, highlighting substantial room for improvement. UK-PRBench provides a standardised benchmark for evaluating fine-grained precedent retrieval and advancing retrieval systems for the UK legal domain.
2609.24613.paper_summary_zh: 先前案例檢索（PCR）旨在識別與給定查詢案例相關的先例案例。現有的 PCR 基準和方法主要在文件層面運作，將整個判決視為相關性的單位。這種表述對於法律從業者來說並不理想，因為判決涉及多個法律問題，而只有一小部分段落與特定查詢相關。為了解決這一問題，我們引入了 UK-PRBench，這是一個針對英國案例法的段落級先例檢索基準，該基準由來自英國國家檔案館的判決構建，涵蓋了廣泛的英國法院和法庭。此外，我們評估了最先進的檢索模型並建立基準結果。我們的實驗顯示，段落級先例檢索對於當前的檢索方法仍然具有挑戰性，突顯出改進的巨大空間。UK-PRBench 提供了一個標準化的基準，用於評估細粒度的先例檢索並推進英國法律領域的檢索系統。
2609.24613.author: Damith Premasiri et.al.
